title: Live reset probe, anchor-based usage offsets, and audit ledger for reserved quota windows
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: We observe occasional discrepancies at reserved-capacity reset boundaries where customers are either briefly over-throttled (false positives) or allowed to exceed reserved windows (false negatives). Root causes include clock skew between regional schedulers, late-arriving consumption events from edge proxies, and aggressive optimistic resets by the quota controller. Existing fixes (soft rollforward and idempotent fencing) reduce incidence but do not provide an observable, auditable proof that a reset completed correctly for a tenant.
solution_overview: Introduce an anchor-based offset ledger paired with a live reset probe. On each reset boundary (daily/rolling/monthly), compute and persist an anchor token for the tenant window. The offset ledger stores a small per-tenant delta (pre-reset consumption carried forward) and a monotonic ledger_sequence. The live reset probe actively simulates bounded synthetic traffic across timezone boundaries to validate reset semantics and measure reset lag. Design goals: idempotent, observable, reconciliable, and low-overhead for reserved pools.
technical_notes:
- Anchor token: string (tenant_id|anchor_ts|hash) persisted to ledger with sequence id.
- Offset ledger schema: (tenant_id, anchor_ts, sequence, carried_tokens, created_by, source) sharded by tenant_id mod 256.
- Reset executor: write-new-anchor -> snapshot current accumulator -> compute carried_tokens -> swap anchor in memstore -> emit audit event to Kafka -> persist ledger entry.
- Probe: stateless runner deployed globally. At T-30s, probe issues N synthetic consumes with 'probe' flag; at T+2s it reads tenant ledger anchor and reconciliation endpoint to ensure observed state matches ledger.
- Idempotency: each reset uses a checkpoint token (ledger.sequence) to avoid duplicate double-resets on retries.
- Reconciliation: async job compares ledger entries vs token-level ingestion (raw usage stream) and emits corrections as adjustment events; adjustments are signed and stored in an immutable audit partition.
- Telemetry: reset_success_rate, reset_lag_seconds (p50/p95/p99), ledger_compaction_backlog, probe_discrepancy_rate.
- API compatibility: /quota/consume will begin returning optional fields: "ledger_anchor" and "ledger_seq" for debug traces (feature-flagged).
- Storage concerns: ledger entries are compacted monthly; compaction respects retained audit windows for compliance customers.
- Performance: write-path designed to be O(1) per reset; probes limited to synthetic traffic budget to avoid affecting real capacity.
acceptance_criteria: Live reset probe detects and reports boundary anomalies in staging with >99% detection sensitivity for injected discrepancies
Reset executor writes durable anchor ledger entries and exposes ledger_seq visible to /quota/consume traces (feature-flag enabled)
Reconciler job demonstrates correction capability for late events with end-to-end test showing ledger -> raw_stream -> adjustment_event cycle within 5 minutes in staging
No increase in 99th percentile quota-op latency >10ms after enabling ledger writes for reserved tenants
Runbook updated and on-call playbook includes steps to read ledger entries and issue manual corrections
Canary rollout to 10% reserved tenants with monitoring thresholds and automatic rollback on error conditions
rollout_plan: Build and land ledger schema + write path behind feature flag (billing-2026.1)
Deploy reset executor changes to staging; run full probe suite across regions; validate metrics for 72h
Enable ledger trace fields in /quota/consume for internal tenants only; get sign-off from Billing and Infra
Canary: enable for 10% of reserved customers for 48h; monitor reset_success_rate and probe_discrepancy_rate
Expand to 50% for 7 days with stricter reconcilers running; monitor compaction backlog
Full rollout and enable monthly compaction; deprecate old manual reconciliation scripts
comments: 2026-03-03 | Sofia Martinez: Initial triage — reproduced drift on staging by advancing edge proxies' clocks; suspect stale proxies batching. Created design doc and spike tasks.

2026-03-05 | Ethan Liu: Spike implemented; anchor write + memstore swap works locally. Observed a corner case where two reset executors in different AZs concurrently attempt anchor_write -> fixed by adding ledger.sequence CAS.
2026-03-08 | Priya Ramesh (Billing): Reviewed approach; requested an immutable audit partition for compliance customers and ability to export ledger slices for invoicing audits.

2026-03-10 | Ethan Liu: Probe runner PoC deployed to staging (us-west/us-east/eu); probe budget set to 0.05% of reserved capacity. Early runs found 3 tenants with >30s reset_lag due to regional firewall rules — raised ENG-525430.

2026-03-12 | QA: Added e2e tests covering late-arrival raw events producing adjustment events; one flaky test failing due to eventual consistency window — increasing wait time but adding tighter assertions on ledger_seq ordering.
2026-03-14 | Sofia Martinez: Decided to feature-flag ledger fields in public API; billing team requested 2-week internal-only canary before external exposure. Scheduling canary start 2026-03-18.
